78058.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Bernstein sees bitcoin hitting $150K by mid-2027
78058.body:
'Altitude sickness can wait': Bitcoin's historic short squeeze, Bessent catalyst may signal bull-market reset, analysts say | SEC sends crypto custody rule changes to White House for review | Revolut begins phased EURR stablecoin rollout in Denmark, Poland and Portugal | Kalshi raised $1.12 billion via private equity offering since April, latest SEC filing shows |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented By:

( https://thezcashetf.com/?utm_campaign=website-traffic-zcsh-newsletters--2026-08-25&utm_medium=paid-other&utm_source=the-block&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Wednesday! Core *PCE* landed in line at 3.3% in July, but a hotter headline print pushed September *Fed* hike odds to around 44% from 36%. *Sygnum* CIO *Fabian Dori* told The Block structural liquidity remains key for digital assets, while *Capital.com's Daniela Hathorn* flagged *Jackson Hole* as the next major macro risk for *bitcoin*.

In today's newsletter, *Bernstein* sees *bitcoin* hitting $150,000 amid the "debasement trade," *Scott Bessent* provides an additional macro catalyst for *bitcoin* , the *SEC* sends its crypto custody rule changes for *White House* review, and more.

Meanwhile, *Tornado Cash* developer *Roman Storm's* retrial ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-26-tornado-cash-roman-storm-retrial-april-2027-412761?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) has been pushed back to April 2027.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Fed* Chair *Kevin Warsh* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*📈 Bernstein sees bitcoin reaching $150,000 by mid-2027 amid 'debasement trade,' but cuts Strategy target to $350*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-08-26-bernstein-sees-bitcoin-reaching-150000-by-mid-2027-amid-debasement-trade-but-cuts-strategy-target-to-350-412778?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Analysts at research and brokerage firm *Bernstein* expect *bitcoin* to hit a new all-time high of $150,000 by mid-2027 under their base case, before peaking around $300,000 in 2029, arguing a broad "debasement trade" will add a macro tailwind.

* The analysts said the 40-year era of falling interest rates is over, with U.S. sovereign debt at $40 trillion and climbing, pushing policymakers toward currency debasement, which tends to lift scarce assets like bitcoin.
* Bernstein's thesis is also showing up in ETF trading, with *Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas* noting the "debasement trade" is starting to replace "AI mania" as *bitcoin* and gold funds reenter the top 10 most-traded ETFs and displace some semiconductor funds that dominated the rankings over the summer.
* In a more aggressive scenario, Bernstein sees bitcoin reaching $200,000 by mid-2027 and potentially $500
